avg_monthly_income.description: Average monthly income over last 3 months (₹)

income_volatility.description: Coefficient of variation of monthly income (0=stable, >0.3=volatile)

income_trend.description: Normalized slope of income over last 6 months (negative=declining)

months_since_last_income.description: Months since the last income credit was received

avg_monthly_essential_spend.description: Average monthly essential expenses over last 3 months (₹)

avg_monthly_discretionary_spend.description: Average monthly discretionary spending over last 3 months (₹)

essential_to_income_ratio.description: Essential spending / income ratio (>0.7 = budget very tight)

burn_rate_trend.description: Normalized slope of total monthly spending (positive = increasing)

spending_spike_count.description: Number of months where spending exceeded 1.5x the 3-month average

avg_balance_30d.description: Average balance over the last 30 days (₹)

min_balance_30d.description: Minimum balance hit in the last 30 days (₹)

balance_trend.description: Daily balance change rate (₹/day, negative = declining)

days_until_zero.description: Projected days until balance reaches zero at current burn rate

total_emi_burden.description: Total monthly EMI obligation across all loans (₹)

emi_to_income_ratio.description: Total EMI / monthly income (>0.5 is a red flag)

missed_emi_count.description: Number of EMIs missed in the dataset timeframe

emi_payment_consistency.description: Percentage of EMIs paid on time (1.0 = perfect)

medical_spend_spike.description: Current month medical spend / historical average (>3 = spike)

income_drop_flag.description: Binary flag: 1 if income dropped >40% month-over-month

large_unexpected_debit.description: Count of individual debits exceeding 3x average monthly debit
